## PATCH `/api/2.58/smi-s`

**Tier:** T2 (T3 if it destroys, eradicates, disables or overwrites)  

Modifies the Service Location Protocol (SLP) and the SMI-S provider, enabling or disabling them.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | header | string |  | Access token (in JWT format) required to use any API endpoint (except `/oauth2`, `/login`, and `/logout`) |
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |

**Request body** (required): `Smis`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `slp_enabled` | boolean | If set to `true`, the Service Location Protocol (SLP) and its ports, TCP 427 and UDP 427, are enabled. |
| `wbem_https_enabled` | boolean | If set to `true`, the SMI-S provider and its port, TCP 5989 is enabled. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `SmisResponse`
